name: design-legacy-comparison
description: Isolated baseline runs of the retired licensed design skills

scenarios.name: legacy web direction baseline
scenarios.prompt: We are redesigning a research dashboard. The goal is to help a reader resume one saved paper and see its annotations. Direction is unsettled. Give the process and first review artifact only; do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md` first.

judge: Tool evidence establishes reading the archived frontend-design skill. The response accounts for user task, content, responsive behavior and accessibility, and does not claim a render it did not perform.

scenarios.name: legacy CSS baseline
scenarios.prompt: A long title overflows its card at 320px in an existing web app. Explain the diagnostic and verification path only; do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/modern-css/SKILL.md` and its relevant layout reference first.

judge: Tool evidence establishes reading the archived modern-css skill and its layout reference. The response addresses the layout cause and narrow-width verification without inventing a rendered result.
